name: calf-raise-smith-machine-reverse
title: Calf Raise: Smith Machine (Reverse)
primer: This is a unique exercise that works the tibialis anterior muscle, at the front of the shin.
steps: Place a block or low box under the bar at a Smith Machine.
Stand with your heels on the edge of the box and the front of your feet hanging off.
Place the bar across your shoulders and lift your toes as high as possible.
tips: Use the bar for support as you perform this exercise.
